basic_info.description: Located off Lake Street, this light-filled, top-floor, 2-bedroom home is designed for modern living. Updated in 2022, the open plan layout maximizes space and functionality. West facing living room features large windows and opens directly on to the update chef's kitchen. Kitchen features new appliances, ample storage space and an eat-at-bar. Both bedrooms feature generous closet space and plenty of natural light, creating a serene retreat. The bathroom is thoughtfully designed with sleek and stylish updates. The home has in unit washer/dryer, air conditioning and a one car parking spot. Ideally situated within walking distance to Mountain Lake Park and the Presidio as well as the restaurants and stores on California and Clement Streets. Quick drive to stores of Laurel Village, including Bryan's and Cal Mart. Easy access to public transportation. Walkscore of 98.
